descriptions.zh: 曾经威胁我们家园的战舰仍然高悬在头顶，严酷地提醒着我们侥幸逃脱的命运。现在该去夺回我们的天空，取回这艘舰船残骸中的高超科技了。
descriptions.en: The warship that once threatened our homeworld still looms over us, a stark reminder of the fate we narrowly escaped. It is time to take back our skies and salvage the technological marvels contained within the wreck.

descriptions.zh: 修复这艘坠毁的运奴船的电脑核心应该可以令我们找到自己母星的位置……同时也是弥那玛特种实业集团的母星。
descriptions.en: Repairing the computer core of the crashed slaver ship should reveal the location of our former home worlds... as well as Minamar Specialized Industries.

descriptions.zh: 一座环绕着§Y[From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]§!的废弃观测站。从中可以一窥在这个行星上的前超光速的§Y夏瑞诺伊§!文明的起源。
descriptions.en: An abandoned observation outpost orbits §Y[From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]§!. It may shed some light on the origins of the pre-FTL §YCharynoi§! civilization on the planet below.
